referenceDescription: Real God of War Ragnarok gameplay screenshots used as the uncompromised production-quality bar for combat readability, camera, lighting, materials, environment density, silhouette, effects hierarchy, HUD integration, and authored finish.
privacyRule: No supplied reference pixel, crop, thumbnail, contact sheet, derived board, or encoded copy may enter Git, a blind ballot artifact, a user-visible report, or a shared package. Only this archive receipt, textual observations, and hashes of ephemeral private boards may be recorded.
candidateEvidenceRule: Candidate full frames and clips remain evaluator-created evidence. Reference-matched boards are private evaluator aids only and cannot replace unmodified candidate evidence.
